CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn OFF auto splatter and use this button to trigger splatters instead. Every time you click, another one dies. You monster.
CONTROLS.NAME: manual_splatter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for automatic blood splatters on the beat, turn off if you want to use the manual splatter button.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_splatter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Choose whether the extra, slow drips are included in each splatter.
CONTROLS.NAME: extra_drips

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for automatic slices on the beat, turn off you want to use the manual slice button.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_slicer

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for high-contrast slices instead of red.
CONTROLS.NAME: constrast_slices

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn OFF auto slicer and use this button to trigger slices instead. Splatter wasn't enough? Do you have an insatiable thirst for blood?
CONTROLS.NAME: manual_slice

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn ON for a glitch effect when the highs hit.
CONTROLS.NAME: highs_glitch

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn this up to increase the intensity of the blood.
CONTROLS.NAME: more_blood

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn this up to decrease the intensity of the blood.
CONTROLS.NAME: less_blood

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Hit this to push the blood out radially.
CONTROLS.NAME: punch_out

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Hit this to pull the blood in towards the center.
CONTROLS.NAME: punch_in

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn this up to make the punch effect of the two buttons more intense. High values can turn the scene into a sort of tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: intensity_punch
